dedupe_keys.name: secretaria regional do ambiente e acao climatica governo dos acores flood hazard datasets

description: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores : flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plano de Gestão de Riscos de Inundações (PGRIA 2022-2027) - Região Aut; Cartografia de Riscos Naturais - Áreas de Risco de Galgamentos e/ou In; Cartografia de Riscos Naturais - Áreas de Risco Potencial Significativ; Plano de Gestão de Riscos de Inundações (PGRIA 2016-2021) - Região Aut. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
